name: OWASP Top 10 (Web Application Security Risks)
description: The ten most critical web application security risks, as ranked by the OWASP community.

name: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications
description: The ten most critical security risks specific to applications built on large language models.

name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI Applications
description: Security risks specific to autonomous, tool-using AI agents, including excessive agency and multi-agent trust boundary failures.

name: OWASP API Security Top 10
description: The most critical security risks to APIs, distinct from the general Web Top 10.

name: OWASP Client-Side Top 10
description: Security risks that manifest in browser-executed, client-side application code.

name: OWASP Top 10 CI/CD Security Risks
description: The most critical security risks in continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.

name: OWASP Automated Threats to Web Applications (OAT)
description: A catalogue of automated threats (bots, scraping, credential stuffing, and related abuse) against web applications.

name: OWASP Mobile Application Security Verification Standard
description: A standard for mobile app security, defining verifiable security requirements across seven categories.

name: MITRE ATLAS
description: Adversarial Threat Landscape for Artificial-Intelligence Systems: real-world tactics and techniques against ML-enabled systems.

name: CompTIA SecurityAI+ (SecAI+) and Security+ SY0-701
description: Vendor-neutral certification topics covering foundational security and AI/LLM-specific security knowledge.

name: STRIDE Threat Modeling (Microsoft Elevation of Privilege)
description: A threat-modeling mnemonic and card-based methodology: Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information Disclosure, Denial of Service, Elevation of Privilege.
